name: Brass Spittoon
blurb: A dented brass spittoon, polished by years of careless aim.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Art is in the classic block, but the Britannia map uses it only once (ML region): unverified.

name: Dirty Iron Pot
blurb: An iron pot with last week's supper burnt into the bottom and no one willing to scrub it.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Used 6 times in map statics (Wrong dungeon and elsewhere).

name: Bloody Bandages
blurb: A crumpled pair of bloodied bandages, tossed aside after a rough night.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Used 6 and 12 times in map statics (Wrong, Papua, Serpent's Hold).

implNote: decor-only static; not a usable bandage

name: Scrub Brush
blurb: A worn wooden scrub brush with bristles bent to the shape of its owner's hand.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Used a handful of times in classic towns (Vesper, Delucia).

implNote: decor-only static; not a usable tool

name: Wig Stand
blurb: A turned wooden head on a stand, waiting for a wig that has long since gone to market.

era.note: Barber-shop dressing, but this stand is unused in the Britannia map. Plausible shop dressing, unverified.

name: Large Amphora
blurb: A tall, two-handled amphora of grey-brown clay, shaped by a patient hand.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Large vases are named among the classic shop rares and used in Wind, Delucia and mainland statics.

implNote: decor-only static (vase graphic; not a container)

name: Ceramic Vase
blurb: A slender-necked ceramic vase, plain and pleasing, meant for a single stem.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Large vases are named among the classic shop rares and used in Wind, Delucia and mainland statics.

name: Large Clay Urn
blurb: A wide-bellied clay urn banded with shadows, big enough to hold a season's grain.

era.note: Classic NPC shop-dressing rare; players carried these off until Publish 5. Large vases are named among the classic shop rares and used in Wind, Delucia and mainland statics.

implNote: decor-only static (urn graphic; not a container)

name: Small Clay Pot
blurb: A small brown clay pot with a pinched rim, forever empty.

era.note: Same vase block as the large clay urn, but the Britannia map uses this pot only in Khaldun (Sept 2000, after the window). Unverified.

name: Cobalt Amphora
blurb: A two-handled amphora glazed in deep cobalt blue, with a shine like the open sea.

era.note: Recolour (hue 1266) of the large amphora art, which carries the base grade. A shard-made variant, not a documented item.

name: Gilded Amphora
blurb: An amphora coated in beaten gold leaf, a gift fit for a guildmaster's mantel.

era.note: Recolour (hue 1161) of the large amphora art, which carries the base grade. A shard-made variant, not a documented item.

name: Jade Vase
blurb: A slender vase in cool green jade, polished until it glows.

era.note: Recolour (hue 62) of the ceramic vase art, which carries the base grade. A shard-made variant, not a documented item.

name: Oxblood Urn
blurb: A great urn glazed the deep red of old wine, heavy and dark.

era.note: Recolour (hue 1157) of the large clay urn art, which carries the base grade. A shard-made variant, not a documented item.

name: Stone Demon Face
blurb: A horned demon face carved from grey stone, its mouth set in a permanent sneer.

era.note: Stone faces are used 7 and 3 times in the Shame and Deceit dungeons (classic dungeon dressing). Decor-only: no trap function.

implNote: decor-only static; strip fire-trap logic (stock fire-trap face graphic)
